summary: First iteration: backend + frontend both tested for Absensi Sekolah SaaS. Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 36 pytest test cases covering auth (3 roles), owner (overview/schools/create+delete), invoices (generate/list/public/PDF/mock-pay/idempotency), admin (stats/settings/locations/teachers CRUD+enroll/students CRUD+CSV import preview+commit/leaves list+decision/reports json+xlsx+pdf), teacher (leave create+list), and kiosk (info valid/invalid/attend face_not_found & geofence). All 36 tests PASSED (100%). Frontend Playwright tests validated: 3-role login, language ID/EN toggle, owner dashboard shows SMA Nusantara+KIOSK-DEMO-1, owner invoices page renders + generate btn present, admin all tabs load (Teachers has Budi, Students has import file input, Settings shows kiosk code+save+loc buttons, Leaves loads, Reports has xlsx+pdf export buttons), kiosk invalid code shows 'Kode kiosk tidak valid', kiosk valid code pairs and shows school name, Pay page shows amount + pay-now-btn triggers mock-pay -> pay-success visible ('Invoice ini sudah LUNAS'). Mobile viewport 390px: login/owner/kiosk/pay all render without horizontal overflow.

issues: Uses browser-native date/month inputs (input type='month' for invoice period; input type='date' for report date range) instead of a shadcn Calendar/Popover component. Consider replacing for consistent branded UX across browsers.

action_items: (Optional/polish) Swap native <input type='month'> in OwnerInvoices and native <input type='date'> in admin Reports for shadcn Calendar+Popover to keep dark-theme consistency and improve mobile UX.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py verify_password will raise ValueError if a stored hash is not valid bcrypt (e.g. legacy/plain). Consider try/except -> return False for robustness.

routes_billing.py: /webhooks/tripay updates invoice by data['merchant_ref'] as invoice id, but generate_invoices does not send merchant_ref to Tripay anywhere (only mock mode is used). Fine for MOCK mode; ensure merchant_ref = invoice.id when Tripay real is enabled.

routes_kiosk.py _record: HTTPException raised inside offline path only when geofence not ok and offline is False. Overall logic OK; but for offline=True and outside geofence, status is set to 'rejected_geofence' and record is still saved — verify this is desired for auditability (currently is).

routes_admin.py report_export: passes user dict positionally to internal helper report_attendance which expects Depends; the direct call works only because the function ignores that dep. Slightly fragile — consider factoring internal query helper.
server.py seed(): if owner exists but password mismatch, it silently rewrites password_hash. Documented as by-design idempotent seed per playbook. OK.

routes_owner.py create_school: HTTPException 400 for duplicate admin_email is fine, but does not roll back if failure occurs after school insert. Consider transactional cleanup or ordering (users first). Low priority.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Since auth uses Bearer tokens (not cookies) it works, but should be tightened (explicit origins) before enabling cookie-based auth.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Only cosmetic feedback about native date pickers. If a follow-up bug fix touches invoice/pay/kiosk, rerun /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (uses parallel workers, ~10s). Frontend camera-driven kiosk attend was not exercised end-to-end (grantPermissions('camera')+fake media requires launching Chromium with --use-fake-device-for-media-stream; skipped since face-hash simulation match with fake frames is nondeterministic). The kiosk UI pairing, mobile layout, invalid code error, and school name display were all verified. Invoice email delivery via Emergent Resend was not verified (send_email=false in tests to avoid outbound); API accepts send_email=true (previous smoke-test noted 200).
